Subject: Vendor account update and primary contact change

Hi Rishi / Marissa,

Quick note from Meridian — our bank (Northbridge National) completed a systems consolidation last weekend and we need to update the banking details you have on file to avoid any failed ACHs for upcoming invoices. Also, Jordan Hayes (jonathan alias; CC'ed) will be our new AP primary contact going forward.

Attached are the completed Meridian vendor update form and a photo of a voided check. Files: Meridian_Vendor_Update_Form.pdf, Meridian_Void_Check.jpg.

Can you confirm what verification you need from our side (micro-deposit, voided check, W-9, etc.) and whether this can be effective for payments issued after 03/25/2026? We have one invoice due 03/28 that we'd prefer to have routed to the new account if possible.

Thanks — Elena
Elena Cruz

Hi all — thanks for the heads up, Elena. Quick checklist from AP to move forward: 

1) Supplier change form (received) — good.
2) Voided check (received) — good; we'll use to pre-populate ACH info.
3) Updated W-9 (needed) — please attach.
4) Internal verification: we do a micro-deposit in parallel for first-time ACH routing to a new account — this usually takes 1-2 business days once initiated.
5) Open POs: if the invoice for 03/28 is for work already completed, we can try to route payment to the new account but it may slip to the next AP run depending on timing; if Meridian prefers, we can reissue a PO to make routing explicit. Please confirm preference.

I've attached our supplier-change-checklist for vendor reference. Also noting: for any bank changes we require a signed acknowledgement from the vendor that the change request is legitimate (this helps satisfy audit controls). Elena, can Jordan or you reply with a brief line confirming the request and attach the W-9?

Next steps:
- Elena: send W-9 and confirmation from Jordan
- AP (ap-ops): initiate micro-deposit and confirm once completed
- Rishi / Laura: confirm whether to reissue PO if requested

Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Accounts Payable
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
